summary.plain: A mountaintop observatory in southern Arizona with one of the largest collections of optical telescopes in the world. Its 4-metre Mayall telescope now serves the DESI survey of dark energy.
summary.technical: NSF NOIRLab observatory on Kitt Peak, Arizona, at about 2100 m, founded 1958. Operates the 4-m Nicholas U. Mayall telescope on behalf of the DESI survey.
